snippet.title: Sink My Bricks! | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4433220/Sink_My_Bricks

Sink My Bricks! is a co-op pirate roguelite sandbox for 1-4 players. A fully destructible world made of bricks, battles with sea monsters, and modular characters instead of the usual health bar. Plunder, smash, turn physics against your enemies and survive together!

#sinkmybricks #shivermybricks #trailer
